results.text:
How Somatic Work and Inner-Child Reparenting Fit Together

In my experience, EFT, Somatic Experiencing, trauma-sensitive yoga, gentle shaking or qigong, non-forced longer exhales, and gentle Buteyko-style breathing can help the body relax and soften tension around the solar plexus or abdomen so heart chakra love becomes easier to access.

That is where somatic work connects to inner-child work for me. Once the body softens even slightly, I don't have to go digging into a painful memory. I can bring to mind a pet, a baby, a friend, a partner, or anybody I naturally love, feel the actual love that is already there, and see if a little of it can move from the heart toward the younger part around the solar plexus and then back up again in a loop.

This is also why I don't put inner-child reparenting all the way at Job 5. Some of it can start early. If somebody is flooded, almost completely identified with the child-state, or can't access a Nurturer or Protector at all, I would go much smaller: orientation, outside safety, a neutral witness, borrowed adulthood, or one ordinary Protector action. Gentle present-focused self-hypnosis can fit there too. Deep hypnosis or immersive child dialogue is a different thing.

Brainspotting can also be used for resourcing or for going straight into charged material. With diffuse developmental or relational trauma, EMDR may fit better after some basic reparenting, when there is already at least a Nurturer or Protector to help hold what opens. A stable person with one discrete traumatic event may be ready for EMDR much earlier.

For the deep stuff, I want the same basic test: can you stay present, stop voluntarily, and come back to ordinary life afterward?
